_note: A13 measured on hardware: Arty A7-100T, xc7a100tcsg324-1 (-1 speed grade), Vivado 2025.2 default strategy.  Three separate JTAG programming passes, three report blocks each; all nine blocks are identical to the cycle.  DMIPS/MHz and CoreMark/MHz are exact integer ratios of mcycle counts and do not depend on the clock frequency; Dhrystones/sec and the raw CoreMark score do, and are quoted at clk_hz.  See docs/a13-benchmarks.md.
